content: Diastole refers to the phase of the cardiac cycle during which the heart muscle relaxes following a contraction. Ventricular diastole specifically describes the relaxation of the ventricles, while atrial diastole refers to the relaxation of the atria. This allows blood that has accumulated in the left atrium to flow into the left ventricle. The term diastolic is used to describe the relaxation phase of the heart between contractions.
